# Reject a successful native verify exit when no signature was found

RNP.verifyDetached calls getVerifyDetails after the native verify operation. If no signature was found, it changes a zero exit code to -1 and sets BAD_SIGNATURE. It preserves an existing nonzero exit code. Native operation success therefore does not establish that a detached signature exists. The separate missing MIME input and display-sink guards reuse earlier notes. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and review discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/extensions/openpgp.
